The '''Republic broadcast tower''' was a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] broadcast tower operated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Network Security District]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:Backdoor" />
